subject: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@zenora.com>, Tim Lee <tim.lee@zenora.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Hi Ava / Tim,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great convo. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Summary of pain points we heard:
- Latency spikes on your streaming endpoint for short interactive queries (p50 ok, p95 often >300ms).
- Inconsistent semantic search results across models — current embeddings and reranker pipeline yields noisy top-5 results.
- Need deterministic structured outputs for invoice parsing and downstream routing.
- Security/architecture constraint: must support Private/VPC deployment (or strict egress controls) for POC.

Goals you shared:
- Proof-of-concept by end of Q3 with clear success criteria.
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for short queries (<=128 tokens).
- Consolidate vector store and move reranking to a lightweight on-demand job.
- Maintain <1% regression on production QA evaluation for reranker.

Integration / product fit notes:
- Streaming & function calling: we’ll enable chunked streaming with function-calling hooks so you can trigger structured parsers on the fly.
- SDK changes: small patch to the JavaScript/TypeScript SDK to expose structured-output schemas + streaming callbacks. Dylan will prepare a snippet.
- Embeddings/reranking: recommend using our embeddings endpoint + a lightweight on-host reranker to reduce requests; we can provide an optimized reranker recipe and parameter suggestions.
- Security: Redwood Private (VPC) is available for the POC — includes KMS integration and audit logs.

Action items / owners:
- Redwood (Marissa / Dylan): provide demo account, SDK snippet for function-calling + streaming, and a one-page integration plan (attached: demo_plan_v1.pdf).
- Zenora (Ava / Tim): share a sample of typical user queries and a small labeled set for reranker tuning (you mentioned a 2k-query slice). You attached the SOC2 questionnaire request — we included an initial template (SOC2_questions_v1.xlsx).
- Schedule: propose a live demo the week of May 8; available slots: Tue/Thu morning PT.

Please confirm that the recap looks right and share the sample dataset and any POC success criteria you want us to prioritize. I’ll loop Dylan in to send the SDK snippet and proposed timeline.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AEs, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: demo_plan_v1.pdf (1 page; stub), SOC2_questions_v1.xlsx (worksheet; stub)

From: Ava Chen <ava@zenora.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Tim Lee <tim.lee@zenora.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect and captures the discussion. A few clarifications and notes from our side:

- Confirmed pain & goals: Spot on. Our infra team requires either Private/VPC or a strictly controlled egress setup during the POC.
- Latency: p95 <200ms is a stretch goal but is what we need for the interactive UI. Can you provide any benchmark numbers for streaming latency with token-level batching?
- Cost: we’re sensitive to token-level cost for reranking — please include ballpark unit economics in the integration plan.
- Sample data: attached a 2k-sample of anonymized queries (sample_user_queries.jsonl). This includes typical conversational prompts and search queries.
- Timeline: May 10 (Tue) at 10:00 AM PT works for a demo — can we do a 45-minute walkthrough + 15 minute Q&A?

Next steps for us:
- I’ll share the internal POC success criteria doc after the sync with infra (should have by Monday).
- We’ll start an internal ticket to enable a Private VPC evaluation.

Looking forward to the SDK snippet and demo.

Best,
Ava Chen
Head of Product, Zenora
ava@zenora.com

Attachment: sample_user_queries.jsonl (2k lines; redacted)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: Redwood integration recap & next steps

Internal notes for follow-up:
- I’ll prepare the JS/TS SDK snippet that exposes structured-output schemas + streaming callbacks. Target: PR with docs by EOD Mon (May 3).
- I’ll also produce a small demo server that shows token-level streaming -> function call -> structured invoice output.
- Action owner list: Dylan (SDK + demo server), Marissa (scheduling + HubSpot deal updates), SE (hand off after demo for deeper integration).
- Need to confirm: Zenora will want Private/VPC for POC. Check with infra about provisioning timeline and cost.

I’ll attach the initial SDK README and a short example in the PR.

—Dylan
